pick_device.title: Choose the transceiver
pick_device.description: An ELDAT transceiver is attached to this machine, so Home Assistant can drive it directly. Pick it, or connect to a bridge if the stick sits on another machine -- which is what a Home Assistant virtual machine needs, because USB passthrough does not carry the control transfers.

bridge.title: Connect to a bridge
bridge.description: Enter the address serving the transceiver. That is the ELDAT Easywave Bridge add-on, or the bridge running on the machine the stick is plugged into.

data_description.port: The port the bridge serves on.

error.cannot_connect: No Easywave transceiver answered. Check that the bridge add-on is running and that no other program is using the stick.
error.cannot_connect_usb: The transceiver is attached but would not open. Check that Home Assistant may access the USB device nodes, and that nothing else is using the stick.

abort.already_configured: This bridge is already set up.

initiate_flow.user: Add a roller shutter or blind

user.title: Add a roller shutter
user.description: Pick a free transmit position, then teach it to the actuator: put the actuator into learning mode and press the shutter's up button in Home Assistant. Easywave gives no feedback, so the shutter's state is assumed rather than measured.

data_description.position: One of the serial numbers stored in the stick. Use a separate position for every actuator.
data_description.key_stop: Many actuators stop on a third key; check the actuator's manual.

user.title: Add a switch
user.description: Pick a free transmit position and teach it to the actuator. For actuators in single-key toggle mode, set both keys to the same code.

user.title: Add a light
user.description: Pick a free transmit position and teach it to the actuator. Only on and off are supported: without feedback a brightness level could never be tracked.

user.title: Add a button
user.description: Sends a single Easywave telegram when pressed. Handy for scenes, and for teaching a receiver.

initiate_flow.user: Add a window or door contact

user.title: Add a contact
user.description: Trigger the contact once so it appears in the list below, then select it. The ELDAT RTS16 in EIN/AUS mode sends key A when it opens and key B when it closes, which is what the defaults assume.

data_description.address: Choose a transmitter that has been heard, or type its address.

error.invalid_address: Select a transmitter or enter its address in hexadecimal.

initiate_flow.user: Add a hand-held or wall transmitter

user.title: Add a transmitter
user.description: Press a key on the transmitter so it appears below, then select it. One event entity is created per key, ready to use in automations.

error.invalid_address: Select a transmitter or enter its address in hexadecimal.

send_telegram.name: Send telegram
send_telegram.description: Sends a single Easywave telegram from one of the stick's transmit positions. Use this to teach a receiver: put it into learning mode, then call this service.

set_led.name: Set LED
set_led.description: Turns the red LED on the transceiver on or off. Useful for identifying which stick you are talking to.

on.name: On
on.description: Whether the LED should light up.
